title: ID0419602-DC/Si-D/CL-[MP / R7 170002131]Comissioning support Error Plugs (C1)
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
After new update and configuration now, the charger are presenting Outlet out of order for Plugs 1, 4 and 5.

additional_info.subject: Notes for Experts
additional_info.body:
Problem Description:
The charger is having issues with the charging plug, when checked yesterday there was multiple instances of Error Polling Coap, need to apply the SECC hotfix 1.4.11. Charging has not have successful charging sessions. Also seen in the SCB that the serial numbers are two different charger ID's. Need to check with region behind this scenario.
Action Performed (L2):
Checked and confirmed from the region that the charger is still in the commissioning phase.
Charger Software Version:
6.1.3
Reason for Handover (L3):
Support needed for commissioning.
Action Required by HQ:
Charger is in Commissioning process, need to provide support.
